description: This file contains utility functions and data class definitions for processing energy analytics data, including computing summaries, detecting anomalies, and preparing data for visualization with Chart.js. It operates on processed energy consumption rows, focusing on kWh metrics and segmenting data by region and date.

classes.name: SummaryMetrics
classes.description: Data class representing aggregated energy usage metrics such as total count, sum, average, and maximum kWh values.

classes.name: AnomalyPoint
classes.description: Data class representing a single detected anomaly point with associated metadata, including date, kWh value, baseline average, percent above baseline, and region.

methods.name: Optional[float] _safe_float(v: Any)
methods.description: Converts a value to float if possible and not NaN; otherwise returns None.

methods.name: Optional[datetime] _parse_iso_datetime(s: str)
methods.description: Parses an ISO 8601 date string into a datetime object, handling 'Z' or offset formats.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _filter_rows_by_region(rows: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]], region: Optional[str])
methods.description: Filters a list of data rows by exact region match if region is specified.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] build_timeseries_for_chartjs( processed_rows: List[Dict[str, Any]], *, region: Optional[str] = None, include_anomaly_series: bool = True, anomaly_threshold_ratio: float = 0.20, )
SummaryMetrics compute_summary_metrics(processed_rows: List[Dict[str, Any]], *, region: Optional[str] = None)
Tuple[float,List[AnomalyPoint]] detect_anomalies( processed_rows: List[Dict[str, Any]], *, threshold_ratio: float = 0.20, region: Optional[str] = None, )
